label: No reason for the existence of a being contingent at w is about that being itself
paraphrase: OPEN bridge (BX1), analyst formulation, attribution deferred: for every being contingent at w, every #312 reason token explaining its existence at w is about some other being: neither its own nature (an intrinsic token, NECESSARY_EXISTENCE_BY_OWN_NATURE_4) nor itself as a circumstance.
